recent.author: Bullets Forever

recent.text: The Wizards have escaped with a 103-99 victory over the Raptors, breaking their eight-game losing streak. AJ Dybantsa recorded his first double-double, with 23 points and 12 rebounds. Anthony Davis had game highs of 25 points and 14 rebounds.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: That's a new season-high and career-high point total for AJ Dybantsa, who has 23 points.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: AJ Dybantsa has his first NBA career double-double.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: At halftime, AJ Dybantsa needs two more rebounds to record the first double-double of his NBA career.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: If you have a DVR, I recommend you rewind back to 3:53 remaining in the second quarter. Anthony Davis just had one of the Wizards' best out-of-area defensive rebounds of the season.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: One of the areas Kyshawn George improved over the offseason is with his no-dip 3-pointers from the corners. He just hit one to put Washington ahead 44-40.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: The Wizards have to do a better job of getting Tre Johnson catch-and-shoot opportunities and to get him the ball when he moves off screens. Too often, he's trying to get his shots through ISOs and after taking several dribbles.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: Early minutes tonight for Will Riley, who checks in with 5:03 remaining in the first quarter.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.author: Washington Wizards

recent.text: Final: Grizzlies 136, Wizards 120 Dybantsa: 21 pts., 5 rebs., 3 assts. Davis: 23 pts., 4 rebs. Young: 13 pts., 2 rebs., 12 assts. Boozer: 29 pts., 7 rebs., 7 assts. 3rd quarter: Wizards outscored 42-18
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: With the Wizards down 131-112 with 2:12 remaining, Brian Keefe has put Bub Carrington into the game. Carrington's consecutive games-played streak continues, and it's now at 179 games.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: Brian Keefe employed a nine-player rotation in the first half after usually using 10 players in the first half. Bub Carrington, who is available to play and has played in all 178 games of his regular-season career, hasn't played yet.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: That AJ Dybantsa offensive rebound just now off of Anthony Davis' offensive-rebound miss is the kind of hustle play the Wizards need so badly.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: With 9:44 remaining in the second quarter, Trae Young has three points and seven assists. Washington leads Memphis 43-37 after a Deandre Ayton dunk off a lob from Young.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: Update: Tre Johnson has been upgraded to available for tonight's game.
recent.author: Washington Wizards

recent.text: The Washington Wizards' loss Sunday night was a new low for this season, an uncompetitive performance that had even Brian Keefe pointing to their next game as a chance for a reset. These were the same old Wizards. Story in @TheAthleticNBA, free to read: https://t.co/khklxueba5
recent.author: Josh Robbins
